newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady as NYMEX unleaded recovers.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady as NYMEX unleaded recovers.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were little changed on Tuesday. Spot prices dipped in early business as U.S. product futures weakened but then steadied when U.S. unleaded futures improved slightly later, traders said.
Prompt ARA Eurograde barges were valued around $208 with Regular around $6 below this.
February barge swaps were around $1 softer on the sell side at $205/$207 with the Feb/March spread at around $3 in contango and then March/April backwardated by around $3.
Prompt cargo bids were stable around $210.

Traders said interest was minimal with little chance of an arbitrage to the U.S. and the IP week of industry functions keeping many players away from their desks. --Colin Wooster, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7456
